checks.ref:
command:repo=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*repo:[[:space:]]*//p' .gnomish/config.yaml | head -1)
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
marker='<!-- gnomish:usage-report -->'
if ! number=$(gh pr list --repo "$repo" --head "$branch" --base main --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty' 2>&1); then
  echo "cannot verify: gh pr list failed: $number"
  exit 126
fi
[ -n "$number" ] || { echo "no open pull request from $branch into main - the deliver stage opens it"; exit 1; }
if ! found=$(gh api "repos/$repo/issues/$number/comments" --paginate \
    --jq ".[] | select(.body | startswith(\"$marker\")) | .body" 2>&1); then
  echo "cannot verify: listing the comments of pull request #$number failed: $found"
  exit 126
fi
if ! printf '%s\n' "$found" | grep -qx '## Factory usage'; then
  echo "pull request #$number has no usage report - run .gnomish/stages/usage-report/report.sh"
  exit 1
fi
